content.text: Bureau of Labor StatisticsProducer Price IndexesPublicationsNews Releases Producer Price IndexesSHARE ON:Search Producer Price Indexes Bureau of Labor Statistics > Producer Price Indexes > Publications > News Releases Producer Price IndexesPublicationsNews Releases Latest PPI News Releases PPI for final demand advances 0.7% in February; services rise 0.5%, goods increase 1.1% 03/18/2026 The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 0.7 percent in February. Prices for final demand services moved up 0.5 percent, and the index for final demand goods advanced 1.1 percent. The index for final demand rose 3.4 percent for the 12 months ended in February.
